prerequisite: evidence/wrench-memory-v1/results.json accepted before any changed-placement construction/test

placement.rotation_pivot: seeded base wrench body center; translate that pivot, rotate wrench and all three supports together

contrast: Previously accepted same-memory base-placement case versus one fresh actor at this predeclared changed placement. Same prompt, experience, robot controls, quality/physical rules and motor skill. This is not a randomized contemporaneous comparison or an efficiency-effect estimate.
unchanged_physics: Robot/hand/table/cameras, tool/nut geometry and mass, inertia in body frames, friction/contact settings, actuator gains/limits, timestep and evaluator stay unchanged. Only declared initial task-object/support positions/orientations differ.
initialization: Transform source XML before model compilation. Use the unchanged HandRuntime initialization and inherited WrenchRuntime execution/observation/evaluation. No object-state writes, welds, contact edits or external forces after initialization.
observation: Same simulator-state assistance, measured tool/palm/nut poses, named contacts and two RGB views. Public geometry metadata reflects actual compiled placement; source world XY is not the current task goal.
acceptance: Independent complete physical task, quality criteria, action/local-policy trace, source-memory adoption and model-conservation checks pass. At least one memory-informed head target uses current nut coordinates and differs from the source world target. Fresh actor and no root action intervention.
preinteraction_checks: Pure XML invariants, compiled geometry/dynamics conservation and two-view initial static render are allowed. No controller trajectory on this reserved layout before the primary native test.
attempts: One primary reserved-case trial. Retain any failure. Further debugging requires explicitly separate development records and cannot be relabeled as the original reserved result.
scope: One same-wrench placement/yaw transfer example. No new-category tool, new robot, vision-only, hardware or distribution-level success-rate claim.
root_role: Launch and monitor only; never choose/write/replace robot actions or supply live strategic hints.
external_services: No DeepSeek, additional external model or remote-workstation calls.
next_gate: Begin new-wrench geometry work only after stage4 is accepted.
